purpose: Retain the failed one-byte Unused Song 2 reconstruction using selector 0x3D with race-family package 03:FB55.

conclusion.statement: Replacing reachable selector 0x3E with unused selector 0x3D while retaining package table 03:FB55 does not reproduce the preserved Unused Song 2 record on the observed APU transfer path.
what_it_rules_out: A one-byte selector substitution into the ordinary 0x3E + 03:FB55 setup/package pair as a sufficient reconstruction of preserved Unused Song 2.
what_it_does_not_rule_out: 03:FB55 contributing reusable package/sample state to Unused Song 2.
A different dormant setup wrapper, preloaded APU state, additional package sequencing, or another control parameter being required alongside selector 0x3D.
